cases.title: Pauli X prepares |1>
cases.summary: The smallest complete state-preparation example: one X gate, exact unitary semantics, and an exact state-action theorem.
cases.limitations: One qubit; no synthesis search is needed.

cases.title: Hadamard prepares |+>
cases.summary: A one-gate preparation of the equal superposition, linked to the complex-unitary certificate used by Lean.
cases.limitations: One qubit; numerical replay is supporting evidence, not the proof.
